question_original: La conectarea unui circuit de linie se recomandă următoarea  ordine a manevrelor:
A_original: separatorul de bare, întreruptorul, separatorul de linie;
B_original: separatorul de bare, separatorul de linie, întreruptorul;
C_original: întreruptorul, separatorul de linie, separatorul de bare.
source_locator: NTE009/10/00 Art29(2–4); line energization switching
ABC_reasoning_PRELIMINARY: A: attempting circuit breaker before connecting line disconnector can make the disconnector interrupt load; B: bus disconnector, line disconnector and finally breaker aligns with no-load switching of separators; C: closing breaker before isolators improper under normal energization.
source_scope_conditions_and_limits: The particular order of bus then line disconnector may depend on energization plan, remote end, grounding and interlocks; other safe order of isolators possible.
next_gate: Exact approved switching sheet and phase/line state; independent HV operation QA.

question_original: La deconectarea unui circuit de linie se recomandă următoarea  ordine a manevrelor:
A_original: separatorul de linie, întreruptorul, separatorul de bare;
B_original: întreruptorul, separatorul de linie, separatorul de bare;
C_original: întreruptorul, separatorul de bare, separatorul de linie.
source_locator: NTE009/10/00 Art29(2–4), line deenergization
ABC_reasoning_PRELIMINARY: A: opening line disconnector under load before breaker unsafe; B: open circuit breaker then line disconnector then bus disconnector, matches normal sequence; C: opening bus before line after breaker may be an allowable variant only by approved operational procedure.
source_scope_conditions_and_limits: Requires exact live/grounded line topology, line current, charge/parallel paths and switching order; key B not proven uniquely on all schemes.
next_gate: Primary switching instructions and independent HV operations reviewer.

question_original: Pe măsură ce creşte tensiunea la care se realizează instalaţiile electrice, costul pierderilor de putere Cp este:
A_original: constant
B_original: crescător
C_original: descrescător

ABC_reasoning_PRELIMINARY: A: power loss cost not generally fixed as voltage changes; B: for fixed delivered power and resistance current falls as U rises so I²R generally falls; C: downward tendency under fixed network/load parameters, but unit cost and conductor size matter.

question_original: Puterea electrică reactivă:

next_gate: Primary steel-core design handbook and QA on alternatives A/C and original object.
